header.heading: Terms & Conditions

Brand names and logos of clients are used with permission and remain the property of their respective owners.

body.heading: 4. Project inquiries
paragraphs: Submitting the contact form (or emailing hello@jobsite.systems) is how you start a conversation — it is not a contract. No engagement exists until we both sign a separate project agreement that defines scope, timeline, deliverables, and fees.

body.heading: 5. Information you submit
paragraphs: When you submit an inquiry, the information you provide (name, email, business name, service area, project details, message) is used only to respond to you and evaluate fit for a potential engagement. See the Privacy Policy for details on storage and handling.
